claim: A Ukrainian-born PhD washing dishes at Geneva station until Charles Fournier listened.
because: Frank washed dishes at night in Manhattan after arriving in December 1951. He came to the New York State Agricultural Experiment Station in Geneva in April 1952 as a researcher on field nursery practices under Karl Brase, not as a dishwasher. He met Fournier at a Geneva seminar in 1953, and Fournier hired him at Gold Seal in 1954.
fix: A Ukrainian-born PhD who washed dishes in Manhattan, then worked in obscurity at the Geneva station until Charles Fournier of Gold Seal listened.
